messages:
maria_support: FYI customer reported a confusing error from the rerank endpoint. They get '413 Payload Too Large' with no details on which part is wrong. They want prescriptive guidance for trimming input.

olivia_cs: Customer quote: "We posted our entire search results page (900KB) and got a 413. The UI just says \u2018payload too large\u2019 — we don't know whether to shorten query, remove docs, or truncate text." 

sam_se: Can you paste a minimal repro payload? need to know docs count + example lengths.

maria_support: Repro sent privately: POST /v1/rerank with ~350 docs (avg 2.5k chars each) and a long user query. Body ~920KB. Server response is HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large and body is plaintext: "payload too large". No JSON error object.

jordan_eng: Quick context: rerank has two enforced limits. 1) gateway max request size (currently ~1MB) returns 413. 2) service-level token aggregation limit (tokenized query + docs) returns 400 with structured JSON. In this case gateway 413 is hitting first. Gateway returns a generic 413 without our user-friendly guidance.

maria_support: Customer asks for two things: a) clearer error message telling them which limit they hit (body size vs token limit vs docs count) and b) tips on how to trim safely (truncate docs, sample top-K, or chunking).

jordan_eng: Proposal: enhance gateway 413 to return JSON like: ```{"error":"payload_too_large","message":"request body exceeds limit","limits": {"max_request_bytes":"1048576","recommended_max_docs":200,"recommended_max_cumulative_tokens":8192},"help":"see https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits for trimming strategies"}``` That preserves 413 status but gives actionable fields. Also add human-friendly text for web UI.

sam_se: For quick workaround, advise customers to: 1) reduce docs count (sample or pre-rank), 2) send only excerpt field (first 512 chars), or 3) switch to batched rerank calls (split docs into chunks of ~100). I can add a short KB snippet.

olivia_cs: Can we please fast-track the docs link + example code snippet? Customer is blocked.

jordan_eng: I can do a small change to the gateway to add JSON body on 413 and include the numeric limits. Will create PR with tests. Need to confirm exact byte limit from infra (it's currently 1_048_576 but might vary by region).

maria_support: Thanks. Customer-facing message should call out: "Try trimming docs to <=200 items or total token count <=8k, or use batching. See link." Keep it short.

jordan_eng: Filed: RED-3456 - gateway: enrich 413 response for rerank with limits + docs link. Acceptance criteria: 1) 413 returns structured JSON with numeric limits and help URL, 2) doc KB updated, 3) support playbook with triage steps. Assigning to @jordan_eng. ETA: 3 business days.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: PR #7123 -> staging at 2026-03-19T15:30Z if tests pass.

maria_support: I'll update the customer and add KB steps for immediate workarounds. Thanks all :thumbsup:

olivia_cs: Customer is happy to test a staging response once available. They want to confirm the message helps them choose the right fix.

jordan_eng: Will ping when staging is up and include example payloads to validate the new JSON error content.

maria_support: closing loop here; will post results after customer verifies.
